description: The complete csvlog of the third Gate A1 run (manifest version 3), copied verbatim from the run's evidence. Automatic preparation was off. The run reconciled op0p to op6f (both repeats) and stopped refused_fail_closed at op7b, because negative zero was logged as '-0' and the reconciler expected '-0.0'. No row is altered or removed. The log contains no password. The binding read-back was never judged.
